decisions_made: Phase 10 landed exactly as specified: cs5_completeness : CKValidFC.{u,u} cs5FCIncest phi -> NIKTheorem TS5 phi, honest labelled-system naming/docstring, contrapositive composition via Context.trivialBase/deriv_trivialBase_iff (new small bridging lemmas) + primeLemma + canon_truth_lemma + cs5FCIncest_canonWorld_r + five canon* side-conditions. Used CKValidFC.{u,u} (not an independent second universe v) matching the segment-analogue idiom ckvalidFC_completeness (CKExtension.lean:248) -- the plan's pseudocode CKValidFC.{u,v} is not literally type-correct for a completeness theorem that must instantiate World at the specific canonical model CanonWorld TS5 Atom : Type u.

Phase 11 --lit read of Simpson Ch.8 (S8.1.2/8.1.3/Thm 8.1.4, reflowed L1367-1425) found the soundness direction needs his birelational Lifting Lemma (8.1.3), built on F1/F2 confluence his model has but CSLib's target CKForces semantics (Forcing.lean) deliberately lacks (Wijesekera-style, chosen because bare CK is otherwise incomplete for confluent models). A literal transcription is therefore not available -- flagged as a literature-fidelity deviation, not silently mixed with novel steps.

Forked a sub-agent to verify by hand-derivation whether cs5FCIncest's own conjuncts supply a substitute for the missing F1/F2. CONFIRMED: cs5Incest + r_symBox + transitivity-of-<= derive exactly the needed single-edge F2-analogue (r w u -> w<=w' -> exists u'>=u, r w' u'). Landed as cs5FCIncest_lift, sorry-free, axiom-free.

Decided NOT to mark Phase 11 [BLOCKED]: nothing is stuck, missing a mathlib lemma, or mathematically unclear -- the remaining work (tree-shape invariant, graph-lifting-lemma-for-trees, 12-constructor induction, TClosure validation) is substantial-but-standard proof engineering matching the plan's own H8 sizing (11.1 alone estimated 1-2 dispatches). Used the normal multi-dispatch continuation path (status partial + continuation_context) instead of the Escalation Protocol.

Phase 12 correctly NOT started: the plan's own sequencing note ('it is sequenced last (Depends on: 10, 11) so the state.json blockers rewrite and docstring fixes reflect the final landed completeness + soundness result rather than an intermediate state') explicitly directs deferring it until Phase 11 completes.

Chapter 3 / Theorem 3.3.4 direct Hilbert Fischer-Servi canonical model: reuses none of task 517's landed assets and is blocked for CS5 on the FS/box-backward wall.

Do not attempt to port the F1/F2 argument verbatim; use cs5FCIncest_lift (cs5Incest + r_symBox based) instead.

continuation_context.next_phase_note: Phase 11.1 continuation: build (1) the tree-shape invariant (always instantiate NIK's (boxI)/(diaE) cofinite premise at a label fresh to the whole derivation so far, keeping G tree-shaped), (2) the graph-lifting lemma for trees (propagate cs5FCIncest_lift + ckforces_persistence down a tree's descendants via structural/well-founded recursion -- the tree analogue of Simpson's 8.1.3), (3) the main 12-constructor NIK soundness induction using (1)+(2). Then Phase 11.2 (validate TClosure edges against cs5FCIncest's conjuncts per T/B/4, mirroring cs5_axiom_sound_incest's per-axiom-schema case structure; assemble nik_TS5_soundness). Then Phase 11.3 (nik_TS5_consistent via a one-point reflexive cs5FCIncest model -- this specific corollary does NOT need steps 1-3's tree machinery at all, since a one-point model makes every interpretation trivially unique/lifted -- and can be attempted independently/early if useful). Full architecture and worked derivation in specs/517_labelled_bounded_context_cs5_completeness/handoffs/phase-11-lifting-lemma-handoff-20260719.md and Soundness.lean's module docstring. Phase 12 (bookkeeping) remains blocked on Phase 11 per the plan's own sequencing -- do not attempt it early.
